embeds.title: RaiderHub Link Editing Guide
embeds.description:
Use `.edit` to update links in the RaiderHub embed.

**Command format**
`.edit fieldName <https://new-link-here>`

**Editable fields**
`absenceForm`
`consumableRequestForm`
`raidAssignments`
`thatsMyBis`
`wowSims`

**Examples**
Update the absence form:
`.edit absenceForm <https://forms.gle/example>`

Update the consumable request form:
`.edit consumableRequestForm <https://forms.gle/example>`

Update the raid assignment sheet:
`.edit raidAssignments <https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/example>`

Update ThatsMyBis:
`.edit thatsMyBis <https://thatsmybis.com/>`

Update WowSims:
`.edit wowSims <https://www.wowsims.com/mop/>`

embeds.title: Rules
embeds.description:
- __The link must start with__ `https://`
- __This will NOT work:__
`.edit raidAssignments <docs.google.com/example>`
- __This WILL work:__
`.edit raidAssignments <https://docs.google.com/example>`
- __Only officers with the allowed role can use__ `.edit`.
- __After changing a link, run__ `.raiderhub` to check the updated RaiderHub embed.

embeds.title: If something goes wrong
embeds.description:
If the bot says `Unknown editable field`, you typed the field name wrong.

Use one of these exact names:
`absenceForm`
`consumableRequestForm`
`raidAssignments`
`thatsMyBis`
`wowSims`

If the bot says `Please give me a valid https link.`, your link is missing `https://` at the start.

embeds.title: RaiderHub Channel Commands
embeds.description:
**Create a new RaiderHub channel**
`.newraiderhub`

This creates a new private RaiderHub channel in the RaiderHub category.

The bot names it automatically:
`new-raider-hub-1`
`new-raider-hub-2`
`new-raider-hub-3`

You do not type a channel name.

**Add a raider to the current RaiderHub channel**
`.addraider @user`

Example:
`.addraider @Pepper`

embeds.title: Important
embeds.description:
You must mention the actual Discord user.

Use the real Discord mention:
`@TheirDiscordAccount`

Do NOT type their display name as plain text.

This will NOT work:
`.addraider Pepper`

This WILL work:
`.addraider @Pepper`

The bot needs the real Discord mention so it can find the correct user account and give them access to the private channel.

embeds.title: Where to use these
embeds.description:
`.newraiderhub` can be used by officers with permission.

`.addraider` must be used inside a RaiderHub channel.

embeds.title: What `.addraider` does
embeds.description:
It gives the mentioned user permission to:
- view the channel
- send messages
- read message history
- attach files
- embed links
- react
- use external emojis
- use external stickers
- renames the channel using the mentioned user's displayname

embeds.title: If something goes wrong
embeds.description:
If the bot says:
`Please mention a user to add to this RaiderHub.`

Then you did not use a real `@` mention.

Use:
`.addraider @user`

Not:
`.addraider username`

embeds.title: Other useful commands
embeds.description:
**Post the RaiderHub embed**
`.raiderhub`

This posts the RaiderHub embed with the current saved links.

Use this after `.edit` so you can check if you changed the correct thing.

**Post only the important links**
`.links`

This posts only the important links and documents embed.

Use this if you do not need the full RaiderHub message.

**Refresh every RaiderHub channel**
`.postallrh`

This reposts and pins the RaiderHub info in every RaiderHub channel.

Officer command. Do not press the big shiny button unless you actually mean it.

**Show this guide**
`.help`

This posts this guide. Obviously. Somehow still useful.

embeds.title: R34 Commands
embeds.description:
**Search by tags**
`.r34 <tags>`

Example:
`.r34 kaine_(nier)`

If you do not type tags, the bot uses `2b`.

**Random R34**
`.random`

This grabs a random R34 post.

**Where to use these**
These only work in the allowed R34 channels.

If the bot says `That command only works in the allowed R34 channels.`, you are in the wrong channel. Move your horny ass to the right one.
